d8293ffca8f5e69d6b964ccea65e86f4f38a4632.definition: The difference in age between two partners, and the direction of that difference.
d8293ffca8f5e69d6b964ccea65e86f4f38a4632.gloss: The difference in age between two partners, and the direction of that difference.

d8293ffca8f5e69d6b964ccea65e86f4f38a4632.definition: 두 연인 사이의 나이가 몇 년 차이 나는지를 뜻하며, 어느 쪽이 더 나이가 많은지도 함께 나타낸다. 단순히 나이의 차이만 말하는 경우와 나이 많은 쪽을 밝히는 경우가 모두 쓰인다.
d8293ffca8f5e69d6b964ccea65e86f4f38a4632.gloss: 두 연인 사이의 나이 차이와 그 방향.

d8293ffca8f5e69d6b964ccea65e86f4f38a4632.definition: Diferença de idade entre dois parceiros, que pode ser indicada também pela direção: quem é o mais velho e quem é o mais novo.
d8293ffca8f5e69d6b964ccea65e86f4f38a4632.gloss: A diferença de idade entre dois parceiros e o sentido dessa diferença.

d8293ffca8f5e69d6b964ccea65e86f4f38a4632.definition: Jarak antara usia dua pasangan, termasuk siapa yang lebih tua dan siapa yang lebih muda.
d8293ffca8f5e69d6b964ccea65e86f4f38a4632.gloss: Perbedaan usia antara dua pasangan beserta arah perbedaannya.

d8293ffca8f5e69d6b964ccea65e86f4f38a4632.definition: ความแตกต่างในอายุของคู่ครอง รวมถึงการระบุว่าอีกฝ่ายอายุมากหรือน้อยกว่า
d8293ffca8f5e69d6b964ccea65e86f4f38a4632.gloss: ความต่างระหว่างวัยของคู่ครอง

d8293ffca8f5e69d6b964ccea65e86f4f38a4632.definition: Bir çiftin üyeleri arasındaki yaş farkı. Bu farkın yönü, eşlerden hangisinin daha yaşlı olduğunu da belirtir.
d8293ffca8f5e69d6b964ccea65e86f4f38a4632.gloss: İki eş arasındaki yaş farkı ve hangisinin daha yaşlı olduğu.

d8293ffca8f5e69d6b964ccea65e86f4f38a4632.definition: 名詞。交際相手との年齢の差を表す言葉で、差の大きさだけでなく年上の側が含まれる。
d8293ffca8f5e69d6b964ccea65e86f4f38a4632.gloss: 恋人同士などの年齢差と、どちらが年上かという意味での向き。

d8293ffca8f5e69d6b964ccea65e86f4f38a4632.translation: 年齢差は四歳で、彼女の方が年上だった。
Yaş farkı dört yıldı ve eşlerden kadın daha yaşlıydı.
ความต่างระหว่างวัยของพวกเขาอยู่ที่สี่ปี โดยเธอเป็นฝ่ายที่อายุมากกว่า
Kesenjangan usia mereka empat tahun, dan dia yang lebih tua.
A diferença de idade era de quatro anos, e ela era a mais velha.
두 사람의 나이 차이는 네 살이었고, 그녀가 나이가 더 많았다.

d8293ffca8f5e69d6b964ccea65e86f4f38a4632.text: The age gap was four years, and she was the older one.

d861ee362e3823440ae642b3a082d4fe221e2262.definition: The result of a division, without the part that is left over.
d861ee362e3823440ae642b3a082d4fe221e2262.gloss: The result of a division, without the part that is left over.

d861ee362e3823440ae642b3a082d4fe221e2262.definition: 割り算の結果のうち、余りを取り除いた部分。割り切れない場合は、余りを解决问题的前にした整数部分が商になる。
d861ee362e3823440ae642b3a082d4fe221e2262.gloss: 割り算で得られた、余りを除いた部分。

d861ee362e3823440ae642b3a082d4fe221e2262.definition: 나눗셈의 결과에서 남는 부분을 제외한 수입니다. 나누어떨어지지 않는 경우에는 몫과 나머지를 함께 구합니다.
É o valor obtido ao dividir um número por outro. Quando a divisão não é exata, o quociente é acompanhado de um resto.
d861ee362e3823440ae642b3a082d4fe221e2262.gloss: Quociente é o resultado da divisão, sem a parte que sobra.

d861ee362e3823440ae642b3a082d4fe221e2262.definition: Dalam pembagian yang tidak habis sama, hasil bagi adalah jumlah kelompok ukuran penuh yang dapat dibuat. Sisanya disebut sisa pembagian.
d861ee362e3823440ae642b3a082d4fe221e2262.gloss: Hasil bagi adalah hasil pembagian tanpa bagian yang tersisa.

d861ee362e3823440ae642b3a082d4fe221e2262.definition: ผลหารคือจำนวนที่ได้จากการหาร โดยไม่รวมส่วนที่เหลือค้างไว้ จึงต้องไม่สับสนกับผลลัพธ์แบบรวมทั้งผลหารและเศษ
d861ee362e3823440ae642b3a082d4fe221e2262.gloss: ผลหารจากการหารโดยไม่รวมเศษ

d861ee362e3823440ae642b3a082d4fe221e2262.definition: Bölmede bölünen sayının, bölenle bölümün çarpımından çıkan kısımdır. Türkçede "bölüm" sözcüğü hem bu sonucu hem de bir kurumun birimini adlandırabildiği için bağlam önemlidir.
d861ee362e3823440ae642b3a082d4fe221e2262.gloss: Bölme işleminde kalan hariç elde edilen sonuçtur.

d861ee362e3823440ae642b3a082d4fe221e2262.translation: เมื่อหาร 87 ด้วย 7 ผลหารคือ 12 และเศษคือ 3
Hasil bagi 87 dan 7 adalah 12, dengan sisa 3.
O quociente de 87 por 7 é 12, com resto 3.
87を7で割った商は12で、余りは3である。

d861ee362e3823440ae642b3a082d4fe221e2262.text: The quotient of 87 and 7 is 12, with a remainder of 3.

d86b3bbf276587ea92297dd827cf4f15aa7326f6.definition: The surround-view cameras are on. Severity level 1 — Information / Status. Action: Nothing to do..

d88ed6a0ee76fbf0ed0f82b8f1ba31ae3689e5fb.definition: The state of being estranged from the people around you, from a group, or from your own life.
d88ed6a0ee76fbf0ed0f82b8f1ba31ae3689e5fb.gloss: The state of being estranged from the people around you, from a group, or from your own life.

d88ed6a0ee76fbf0ed0f82b8f1ba31ae3689e5fb.definition: 周囲の人々や社会的な集団、または自分自身の生活から疎外されている状態をさす。reactでの用法では、心地悪さを agency's `alienation` に読み替える。
d88ed6a0ee76fbf0ed0f82b8f1ba31ae3689e5fb.gloss: ，周围の人々や集团、または自らの生活からかけ離れている状態。

d88ed6a0ee76fbf0ed0f82b8f1ba31ae3689e5fb.definition: 어떤 집단이나 surrounding environment에서 자기 자신이 outsider처럼 느끼는 상태를 말한다. 단순히 물리적으로 떨어져 있는 것보다 정서적으로 소속감이나 친밀감을 잃은 데 중점이 있다.
d88ed6a0ee76fbf0ed0f82b8f1ba31ae3689e5fb.gloss: 주변 사람이나 집단, 자신의 삶에서 분리되어 낯선감을 느끼는 상태.

d88ed6a0ee76fbf0ed0f82b8f1ba31ae3689e5fb.definition: Estado de afastamento em relação às pessoas que cercam, a um grupo ou à própria vida. Não é apenas estar sozinho: é sentir-se fora do lugar.
d88ed6a0ee76fbf0ed0f82b8f1ba31ae3689e5fb.gloss: O estado de se sentir estranho às pessoas ao redor, a um grupo ou à própria vida.

d88ed6a0ee76fbf0ed0f82b8f1ba31ae3689e5fb.definition: Alienasi adalah keadaan terasing dari orang-orang di sekitar, dari suatu kelompok, atau dari kehidupan sendiri. Hal ini dapat terjadi meskipun seseorang tetap berada di antara orang lain.
d88ed6a0ee76fbf0ed0f82b8f1ba31ae3689e5fb.gloss: Kondisi merasa jauh dari orang di sekitar, kelompok, atau kehidupan sendiri.

d88ed6a0ee76fbf0ed0f82b8f1ba31ae3689e5fb.definition: ภาวะที่บุคคลรู้สึกแปลกแยกหรือไม่เข้ากับผู้คนรอบข้าง กลุ่ม หรือชีวิตของตน ซึ่งไม่ได้หมายถึงการอยู่คนเดียวเท่านั้น
d88ed6a0ee76fbf0ed0f82b8f1ba31ae3689e5fb.gloss: ความรู้สึกถูกตัดขาดจากผู้คนรอบข้าง กลุ่ม หรือชีวิตของตน

d88ed6a0ee76fbf0ed0f82b8f1ba31ae3689e5fb.definition: Bir kişinin çevredeki insanlardan, ait olduğu topluluktan ya da kendi yaşamından yabancılaşmış olma durumu. Bu hâl, yalnız fiziksel uzaklıkta değil, duygusal veya düşünsel kopuklukta da görülebilir.
d88ed6a0ee76fbf0ed0f82b8f1ba31ae3689e5fb.gloss: Çevredeki insanlardan, bir topluluktan veya kendi yaşamından kopmuş olma hâli.

d88ed6a0ee76fbf0ed0f82b8f1ba31ae3689e5fb.translation: Aynı ekipte yıllarca çalıştıktan sonra ekibinden yabancılaştığını hissetti.
หลังทำงานกับทีมเดียวกันมาหลายปี เขารู้สึกถูกตัดขาดจากพวกเขา
Setelah pindah kota, ia merasa semakin alienasi dari orang-orang di sekitarnya.
Ele trabalhou na mesma equipe por anos e sentiu a alienação crescer dentro de si.
그는 같은 팀에서 여러 해 일했지만 어느새 팀과 자신의 사이에 소외감을 느꼈다.
彼は同じチームで何年も働きましたが、团队に疎外されたmaneKENkenderiveいました。

d88ed6a0ee76fbf0ed0f82b8f1ba31ae3689e5fb.text: He worked in the same team for years and felt alienated from it.

d8e920a6f391000a754b81d90d0d7bcd1ab911d8.definition: A switch on a float that starts or stops the pump when the water level rises or falls.
d8e920a6f391000a754b81d90d0d7bcd1ab911d8.gloss: A switch on a float that starts or stops the pump when the water level rises or falls.

d8e920a6f391000a754b81d90d0d7bcd1ab911d8.definition: タンクなどの水面上に浮かぶフロートと連動し、水位が所定の高さへ達したり下回ったりするとポンプの電源を切り替える装置。
d8e920a6f391000a754b81d90d0d7bcd1ab911d8.gloss: 水位の変化に応じてポンプを起動・停止する、フロート付きのスイッチ。

d8e920a6f391000a754b81d90d0d7bcd1ab911d8.definition: 탱크 안의 부유 물체의 움직임을 감지해 수위에 따라 펌프를 켜거나 끄는 스위치다. 보통 물이 떨어지면 펌프를 멈추도록 설정한다.
d8e920a6f391000a754b81d90d0d7bcd1ab911d8.gloss: 수위가 오르내림에 따라 펌프를 작동시키거나 멈추는 스위치.

d8e920a6f391000a754b81d90d0d7bcd1ab911d8.definition: Chave instalada em uma boia que liga ou desliga a bomba conforme o nível da água sobe ou desce.
d8e920a6f391000a754b81d90d0d7bcd1ab911d8.gloss: Chave instalada em uma boia que liga ou desliga a bomba conforme o nível da água sobe ou desce.

d8e920a6f391000a754b81d90d0d7bcd1ab911d8.definition: Sakelar pada pelampung yang memulai atau menghentikan pompa saat tingkat air naik atau turun. Alat ini digunakan untuk mengatur pompa secara otomatis berdasarkan ketinggian air.
d8e920a6f391000a754b81d90d0d7bcd1ab911d8.gloss: Sakelar pada pelampung yang memulai atau menghentikan pompa saat tingkat air naik atau turun.

d8e920a6f391000a754b81d90d0d7bcd1ab911d8.definition: สวิตช์ติดกับลูกลอยซึ่งเปิดหรือปิดปั๊มตามระดับน้ำที่เพิ่มขึ้นหรือลดลง เพื่อควบคุมการทำงานของปั๊มโดยอัตโนมัติ
d8e920a6f391000a754b81d90d0d7bcd1ab911d8.gloss: สวิตช์ติดกับลูกลอยซึ่งเปิดหรือปิดปั๊มตามระดับน้ำ

d8e920a6f391000a754b81d90d0d7bcd1ab911d8.definition: Su seviyesi yükselip alçalınca pompayı başlatan veya durduran, şalter üzerindeki anahtar. Genellikle bir su tankında kullanılır ve kuru çalışmayı önler.
d8e920a6f391000a754b81d90d0d7bcd1ab911d8.gloss: Su seviyesi yükselip alçalınca pompayı başlatan veya durduran, şalter üzerindeki anahtar.

d8e920a6f391000a754b81d90d0d7bcd1ab911d8.translation: Tanktaki şalter, tank boşaldığında pompayı durdurur.
สวิตช์ลูกลอยในถังจะหยุดปั๊มเมื่อระดับน้ำลดจนถังว่าง
Sakelar pelampung di dalam tangki menghentikan pompa ketika tangki kosong.
A chave de boia no tanque desliga a bomba quando o tanque esvazia.
탱크의 부유 스위치는 탱크가 비면 펌프를 멈춘다.
タンクのフロートスイッチは、タンクが空になるとポンプを停止する。

d8e920a6f391000a754b81d90d0d7bcd1ab911d8.text: The float switch in the tank stops the pump when the tank is empty.
d8e920a6f391000a754b81d90d0d7bcd1ab911d8.translation: Công tắc phao trong bể dừng bơm khi bể cạn.
